title: Open a sub-account for a member
description: Signs on, finds the member by number, reads the base share balance, opens a new sub-account funded from cash, and returns the confirmation number.
goal: Sign on to the teller system, look up member {member_id}, note their Base Share balance, then open a new {account_type} sub-account nicknamed '{nickname}' with an opening deposit of {initial_deposit} funded from Cash, and reach the confirmation screen. Read the confirmation number.

params.name: initial_deposit
params.description: Opening deposit in USD, from cash

outputs.name: confirmation_number
outputs.description: Confirmation number of the new sub-account
